presentation.measurement: Six seconds of native RAF observation after four seconds of warmup in an owned headless Chrome for Testing Metal session. This is a short browser check, not cross-device or steady 60 FPS certification.

defaultNativeComparison.method: SHA256 digests of native particle, affine, auxiliary, flags, pressure, cells, labels, gas, history and phase buffers at frames 1, 5 and 20 after deterministic construction. Compare released v5.41 air module with v5.42 module, with nonlinearGas and vaporClosure disabled. Paused native updates run in the real shared water engine.
defaultNativeComparison.navigation: Each capture loads a unique URL, waits for a new performance.timeOrigin and a complete backend, and verifies host/air SHA256 markers inserted by the owned test server.
defaultNativeComparison.correction: The original identical-URL comparison could retain the current document. It is replaced here by verified fresh-document captures; all nine native comparisons pass.
defaultNativeComparison.currentHostDifference: v5.43 changes only the TOY_VERSION constant. The complete saved v5.42 host matches the current source after reverting that constant. The air module and pressure view are unchanged.
